mergedParams.userDescription: Ethereal, soft-focus text drifting slowly like smoke or fog particles. typo kinetics for titles/captions/other text..

output.title: Ethereal Smoke Typography - Soft Drifting Text Animation

prompts.prompt: Create a 'typokinetics' preset that simulates ethereal smoke particles for text animation. Think of this like compositing smoke footage over text in After Effects - each word should drift independently with organic, turbulent motion. The text should appear to dissolve from sharp edges into wispy tendrils that float upward and dissipate. Use multiple layers of the same text with different blur levels and opacities to create depth, similar to how you'd stack adjustment layers in video editing. Apply subtle color shifts from white to pale blue/purple in the highlights to enhance the ethereal quality. Each word should have slightly different animation timing to avoid mechanical uniformity - like how smoke never moves in perfect synchronization.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: Use BaseLayout with absolute positioning and multiple TextAtom layers per word. Apply containerProps.className='relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden'. For each word, create 3-4 duplicate TextAtom components with staggered timings. Base layer: 'text-white/90', middle layers: 'text-white/40 blur-sm', top layer: 'text-white/20 blur-md'. Use generic effects array with opacity (1 to 0), translateY (-5 to -30), scale (1 to 1.1), and custom filter for blur progression (0px to 8px). Apply turbulence via translateX with sine-wave keyframes (-2 to 2 to -2). Timing: 4-6 second duration per word with 0.3s stagger. Use 'ease-out' for upward motion, custom cubic-bezier(0.45, 0, 0.55, 1) for lateral drift. Performance: Add will-change-transform to containerProps.style. Consider using internal effect presets for the smoke dissipation pattern that can be reused across words.

prompts.prompt: Design a 'typokinetics' preset where text behaves like fog rolling across a landscape. Imagine editing a timelapse where fog creeps through valleys - the text should flow horizontally with varying density and speed. Letters should fade in from transparent, become fully visible, then fade out again as if passing through patches of thick and thin fog. Add a subtle vertical undulation to simulate the fog's reaction to terrain. Use film grain or noise texture overlays to enhance the atmospheric quality. This mimics the layering technique in video editing where you'd composite multiple fog passes at different speeds.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'flex flex-row items-center justify-start w-full h-full'. Use caption data to process words individually. Each word wrapped in BaseLayout with 'relative inline-block mx-2'. Apply TextAtom with base classes 'text-gray-100 font-light tracking-wider'. Create fog effect using multiple generic effects: opacity keyframes (0 to 1 to 0.3 to 1 to 0), translateX (viewport width to negative width over duration), translateY (sine wave -3 to 3 pixels). Add custom CSS filter for blur and brightness oscillation. Use repeatChildrenProps to apply consistent fog behavior. Timing: Set parent duration to 8-10 seconds, use fitDurationTo: 'children' for dynamic adjustment. Each word offset by 0.2s using relative timing. Performance: Transform-only animations for GPU acceleration. Consider creating 'fog-roll' internal effect preset with parameterized density and speed.

prompts.prompt: Build a 'typokinetics' preset inspired by thermal imaging and heat distortion. Text should shimmer and warp as if viewed through rising heat waves - like the effect you see above hot asphalt. In video editing terms, this is similar to using displacement maps or heat distortion plugins. Characters should subtly stretch and compress vertically while oscillating horizontally. Add chromatic aberration by slightly offsetting RGB channels. The overall effect should be hypnotic and dreamlike, with text never quite settling into a fixed position.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Use BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center'. For each word from caption data, create a container with 'relative inline-block'. Apply three TextAtom layers for RGB channel separation: red channel with 'text-red-500/60 absolute', green with 'text-green-500/60 absolute', blue with 'text-blue-500/60 absolute'. Use blend mode 'screen' on containerProps.style. Apply generic effects: scaleY oscillating 0.95 to 1.05, translateX sine wave -1 to 1 pixels with different frequencies per channel. Add custom CSS perspective transform for subtle 3D warping. Timing: Continuous loop over 3-4 seconds per cycle. Use spring easing for organic motion. Create 'heat-wave' internal effect with parameterized intensity. Performance: Limit to 2D transforms where possible, use transform3d for perspective effects only.

prompts.prompt: Create a 'typokinetics' preset that emulates particles dispersing in liquid - like ink dropping into water. Text should initially appear crisp, then slowly diffuse outward with tendrils and wisps spreading in organic patterns. This mirrors the ink bleed effect often created in video editing by filming actual ink in water and compositing it. Individual letters should break apart into smaller fragments that drift away at different rates. Add subtle rotation to fragments as they disperse, and apply gaussian blur that increases with distance from origin.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-visible'. Process caption data to create letter-level animations. For each letter, generate 5-8 fragment TextAtoms with 'absolute' positioning. Use clip-path to create irregular fragment shapes. Apply generic effects array: opacity (1 to 0), scale (1 to 0.3), rotate (0 to random 180 to -180), custom blur filter (0 to 15px). Each fragment has unique translateX/Y targeting random positions in 50px radius. Use radial dispersion pattern from letter center. Timing: 5-7 second total duration, fragments stagger by 0.05s each. Apply ease-in-out for natural acceleration/deceleration. Consider audio-reactive trigger if audio exists - use waveform effects to influence dispersion intensity. Create reusable 'ink-disperse' internal effect preset.

prompts.prompt: Develop a 'typokinetics' preset inspired by aurora borealis - text should shimmer with flowing, curtain-like movements. Imagine editing northern lights footage where colors shift and dance - apply this motion to typography. Text should have a gentle vertical wave motion while colors gradient-shift through ethereal hues (cyan, magenta, green). Add a subtle glow that pulses with varying intensity. This recreates the layering of color correction and glow effects you'd apply in post-production to enhance aurora footage.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full bg-gray-900'. Use word-level processing from caption data. Each word in BaseLayout with 'relative inline-block mx-3'. Apply TextAtom with base 'font-thin tracking-widest text-transparent bg-clip-text'. Use CSS gradient background animated via custom properties. Generic effects: translateY with sine wave (-5 to 5px), custom CSS for gradient animation (linear-gradient shifting hue/saturation), textShadow for glow ('0 0 20px currentColor, 0 0 40px currentColor'). Add opacity pulse (0.7 to 1). If audio exists, use waveform effects to modulate glow intensity based on frequency bands. Timing: 6-8 second loop cycles, each word offset by 0.15s for wave propagation. Use ease-in-out for smooth motion. Create 'aurora-glow' internal effect preset with color palette parameters.

prompts.prompt: Design a 'typokinetics' preset that mimics floating in zero gravity - text should drift slowly with momentum-based physics. Think of this like rotoscoping astronaut footage where objects float and rotate freely. Each word should have its own trajectory, rotating slowly on multiple axes while drifting across the viewport. Add subtle size changes to simulate depth as words move closer or farther. This emulates the 3D camera tracking and depth-of-field effects used in space cinematography.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout container with 'absolute inset-0 perspective-1000'. Process caption words individually. Each word in BaseLayout with 'absolute' positioning, random initial positions. Apply TextAtom with 'text-gray-200 font-medium'. Use generic effects with physics-based animation: translateX/Y (smooth drift across viewport), translateZ (-100 to 100 for depth), rotateX/Y/Z (slow continuous rotation, different speeds per axis), scale (0.8 to 1.2 based on Z position). Add subtle opacity changes (0.6 to 1) for atmospheric perspective. Timing: Long duration 10-15 seconds, each word with unique timing offset. Use linear easing for constant velocity, spring easing for direction changes. Performance: Enable 3D acceleration with transform-style: preserve-3d. Create 'zero-gravity' internal effect preset with configurable drift speed and rotation rates.

prompts.prompt: Build a 'typokinetics' preset where text behaves like smoke signals or vapor trails - letters streak and trail as they move. Similar to motion blur and echo effects in video editing, previous positions should leave fading traces. Text should write on with a leading edge that's sharp, followed by a trail that gradually fades and disperses. Add turbulence to the trail portions while keeping the leading text crisp. This recreates the time displacement and echo effects used in motion graphics.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full'. For each word from caption data, create primary TextAtom plus 4-5 trail TextAtoms. Primary: 'text-white font-normal relative z-10'. Trails: decreasing opacity 'text-white/60', 'text-white/40', 'text-white/20', each with increasing blur. Use generic effects: primary has translateX (entrance from right), trails have same translation with increasing delay (0.1s, 0.2s, 0.3s). Add translateY turbulence to trails only (random -2 to 2px). Apply scaleX to trails (1 to 1.1) for stretching effect. Custom CSS filters for motion blur on trails. Timing: 3-4 seconds per word traverse. Use ease-out for deceleration effect. If audio exists, sync trail intensity to beat detection. Create 'vapor-trail' internal effect preset with configurable trail length and fade rate.

prompts.prompt: Create a 'typokinetics' preset inspired by underwater caustics - text should ripple and refract as if submerged. Imagine the lighting effects you see in underwater footage where light patterns dance across surfaces. Text should have a wave-like distortion that travels across letters, with brightness fluctuations simulating light refraction. Add subtle color shifts toward cyan/turquoise. This mimics the underwater color grading and distortion effects applied in marine videography.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden bg-gradient-to-b from-cyan-900/20 to-blue-900/30'. Process caption data for word-level control. Each word in BaseLayout with 'relative inline-block'. TextAtom with 'text-cyan-100 font-light'. Apply generic effects: custom CSS for wave distortion using scaleY (0.95 to 1.05 in wave pattern), translateY (sine wave -3 to 3px), brightness filter oscillation (0.8 to 1.2). Add textShadow for caustic light patterns. Use SVG filters for more complex refraction if needed. Timing: 4-5 second wave cycles, offset each word by 0.1s for wave propagation. Use sine-based easing for natural water motion. Consider waveform effects if audio present - map low frequencies to wave amplitude. Create 'underwater-caustic' internal effect preset.

prompts.prompt: Develop a 'typokinetics' preset where text materializes like condensation on glass - letters slowly become visible through accumulating moisture. This recreates the practical effect often filmed for titles where breath or steam reveals text. Start with barely visible text, then gradually increase opacity and clarity as if moisture is building up. Add subtle drip animations where some letters appear to have water droplets running down. Include slight refraction distortion around the edges.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full bg-gray-800/10 backdrop-blur-sm'. Use caption data with word-level timing. Each word container: 'relative inline-block'. Primary TextAtom: 'text-gray-100/10 font-medium'. Apply generic effects array: opacity (0.1 to 0.9), custom blur filter (8px to 0px), slight scale (0.98 to 1). For drip effect on random letters: add secondary TextAtom positioned absolutely below, animate translateY (0 to 20px) with opacity fade. Use textShadow for moisture glow: '0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,0.3)'. Add subtle scaleX distortion (0.98 to 1.02) for refraction. Timing: Slow 6-8 second reveal, stagger words by 0.3s. Use ease-in for natural condensation buildup. Create 'condensation-reveal' internal effect preset with moisture density parameter.

prompts.prompt: Build a 'typokinetics' preset that simulates text floating on wind currents like dandelion seeds. Each letter should drift independently with realistic physics - rising and falling on air currents, spinning gently, and following curved trajectories. This mirrors the slow-motion nature footage editing technique where particles are tracked and their motion is emphasized. Add subtle size pulsing to simulate breathing or organic movement. Letters should occasionally cluster together then drift apart.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout container: 'absolute inset-0'. Process caption data to separate individual letters. Each letter: BaseLayout with 'absolute' positioning, initial random positions. TextAtom: 'text-gray-200/80 font-thin'. Complex generic effects: translateX/Y using Perlin noise simulation via multiple sine waves (create curved paths), rotate (continuous slow rotation 0 to 360), scale pulse (0.9 to 1.1), opacity (0.6 to 1 based on 'altitude'). Use custom bezier curves for trajectory: cubic-bezier(0.45, 0.05, 0.55, 0.95). Add clustering behavior via conditional positioning based on time. Timing: Long 12-15 second journeys, each letter unique timing. If audio exists, use waveform effects to influence 'wind strength'. Performance: Batch DOM updates, use transform-only animations. Create 'dandelion-drift' internal effect preset with wind pattern configurations.
